cohort: 100 neonates with suspected sepsis in Pakistan.
finding: Out of 100 neonatal blood samples, 85 were culture-positive, with Staphylococcus aureus being the most common isolate (31.4%), followed by Candida sp (16.5%), and GBS (14.1%), and GBS was more frequently isolated from early-onset neonatal sepsis (EONS) than late-onset neonatal sepsis (LONS).
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with culture-positive sepsis.
